theorem lg_target (p : NNReal) (h : p ≤ 1) : ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure p h true = (p : ENNReal) := by
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure_def, ENNReal.ofNNReal_inj_iff]
  apply eq_of_le_of_ge
  · rw [ENNReal.coe_le_iff]
    intro r
    intros h1 h2
    exact le_rfl
  · rw [ENNReal.coe_lt_one_iff]
    exact h
